_note: boards.json recorded `partial-save-closes-modal-success-toast`: the state
did not exist. PagesTab's bulk confirm dropped the dialog on the same tick
it deleted, and the only report left was whatever toast `deletePage`
happened to raise per page — a message from another surface about a
different unit of work (three toasts for one decision). ConfirmDialog now
takes `success`, holds the dialog for 1.4s on this card, and closes itself.
Measured against the PROBE. 1.4s is by design too short to click into and
far too short to drive a measurement through; the probe passes a no-op
onClose so the dialog's own timer fires into nothing and the card holds
still. Everything up to that point is the real component on the real
branch — the recipe clicks the confirm button rather than a fixture
pre-setting the state.

CONTRAST SCOPE CORRECTED 2026-09-08: was "[data-testid=\"modal-success\"]", which resolved to a subtree holding none of the text under test — ModalRoot PORTALS to the overlay root, so a probe-, scrim- or panel-scoped selector contains no part of the dialog. It reported 0 contrast failures from an empty sweep, which is indistinguishable from a clean screen. `body` is the honest scope for a portalled subject: it covers the dialog and the shell behind it, which is what a person sees. measure.mjs now exits 3 on an empty sweep rather than banking the zero.
